'''Wraith Thirteen''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|callsign]] for a thirteenth member of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Wraith Squadron]],<ref name="Wraith Squadron" /> which usually only had twelve members at a time. [[Gara Petothel]], calling herself Lara Notsil at the time, received the callsign when she joined the squadron.
